winner.transfer(jackpot) inside _sendWinnerJackpot: external ether call to an arbitrary address that happens before pixels is deleted.
currentOwner.transfer(msg.value) inside buy: external ether call to the previous pixel owner executed before ownership is updated.
contractOwner.transfer(msg.value) inside sendOwnerCommission: external ether call forwarding the commission.
newPrice = currentPrice * 2 inside buy: unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
finishTime = 86400 + now inside startGame: game deadline derived from block.timestamp.
uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now)))%(min+max)-min inside _rand: weak randomness plus unchecked modulo and subtraction.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns msg.sender to contractOwner.
msg.sender is used as the mapping key when storing the username.
getUsername returns ownerToUsername[msg.sender].
onlyOwner authorization compares msg.sender against contractOwner.
The buyer and newOwner inside buy is msg.sender.
createPixels assigns pixelToOwner[id] = msg.sender for every created pixel.
Entries of pixelToOwner are keyed by the caller msg.sender.
startGame sets finishTime = 86400 + now, making the deadline depend on block.timestamp.
_rand derives its pseudo-random value from the current block.timestamp.
The game deadline computation consumes block.timestamp directly.
startGame is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
sendOwnerCommission is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
finisGame is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
createPixels is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
buy requires _checkPixelIdExists(id) before the purchase proceeds.
buy calls _transfer to move pixel ownership to the buyer.
finisGame calls _rand to select the winning pixel id.
finisGame calls _sendWinnerJackpot to pay the winner.
createPixels pushes new Pixel structs into the pixels array.
_sendWinnerJackpot performs the winner.transfer(jackpot) external call.
buy performs the currentOwner.transfer(msg.value) external call.
sendOwnerCommission performs the contractOwner.transfer(msg.value) external call.
buy computes newPrice = currentPrice * 2.
startGame sets finishTime = 86400 + now.
_rand evaluates uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now)))%(min+max)-min.
The 10 ether transfer to an arbitrary winner address executes before the pixels array is deleted, so the winner can re-enter finisGame.
Ether is sent to the previous owner before pixelToOwner is updated, allowing the recipient to re-enter buy and take advantage of stale ownership state.
The commission transfer to contractOwner executes inside a payable function and can call back into the contract.
The unchecked multiplication currentPrice * 2 can overflow and corrupt the pixel price.
The game deadline is derived from the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
The modulo and subtraction operations in _rand are unchecked and can wrap around.
buy reads pixelToOwner[id] to determine the current owner.
buy reads pixels[id] to obtain the current price and writes the doubled price back.
finisGame writes the selected winner id into lastWinnerId.
finisGame writes the resolved winner address into lastWinnerAddress.
finisGame deletes the pixels array after the jackpot transfer.
createPixels initialises each new pixel with the startPrice state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The username string parameter exists only as an input to setUsername and should be folded into that function node.
The winner address parameter is only meaningful inside _sendWinnerJackpot and is absorbed by it.
The min bound parameter is specific to the _rand helper and should be merged into it.
The max bound parameter is specific to the _rand helper and should be merged into it.
The amount parameter only controls the createPixels loop and is absorbed by that function.
The id parameter is the sole input of the _checkPixelIdExists helper and should be merged into it.
The destination address parameter is used only by _transfer and is absorbed by it.
The pixel id parameter is used only by _transfer and is absorbed by it.
The id parameter is the external entry input of buy and should be merged into the buy node.
The jackpot local is the constant amount passed to winner.transfer and collapses into that unsafe operation.
The winnerId local is produced and consumed only within finisGame.
The winnerAddress local is produced and consumed only within finisGame.
The loop counter is a temporary of createPixels and should be merged into it.
The id local derived from pixels.push is internal to createPixels.
The loop counter is a temporary of getAllPixels and should be merged into it.
The storage pointer pixel is a read-only temporary inside getAllPixels.
currentPrice is a transient read of pixels[id] inside buy and is absorbed by it.
currentOwner is only used as the recipient of the currentOwner.transfer payout and collapses into that unsafe operation.
newOwner is simply msg.sender captured inside buy and should be merged into the buy node.
newPrice exists only as the result of the unchecked currentPrice * 2 computation and merges into that unsafe operation.
The storage pointer pixel is a temporary handle used to update the price inside buy.
